resources.string: Bike-share, live bus arrivals, estimated metro, and live FGC and Rodalies trains for the Barcelona area.

When you open a bus stop in the Barcelona area, show upcoming buses. Downloads public AMB data and, if you add a TMB key, city-bus arrivals. Respects the mobile data setting. Off by default. The key stays on this device.
Optional. Stored only on this device

Shows approximately where each Barcelona metro train is, in the line colour. Needs the TMB app id and key on this screen. Respects the mobile data setting. Off by default. Positions are estimated, not GPS.
Add a TMB app id and key in BCN Transport to see metro trains.
Shown on the map. Every line is on until you turn it off.
Shows live FGC and Rodalies trains in the Barcelona area, with a direction arrow. Positions come from FGC Geotren and Renfe (CC BY 4.0). No TMB key. Respects the mobile data setting. Off by default.
Shown on the map. Every line is on until you turn it off. Separate from the metro lines.
